autoreconnectrf.name: AutoReconnect
message.autoreconnectrf.installYacl: Install Yet Another Config Lib to access mod options
message.autoreconnectrf.configScreenDisa: Config screen is not available on this version.
Whether to attempt to reconnect if a manual connection attempt fails.
option.autoreconnectrf.attempts.infinite: Whether to continue attempting to reconnect with the last configured delay.
option.autoreconnectrf.conditions.toolti: Conditions allow you to prevent AutoReconnect from attempting to reconnect you, based on the disconnect reason. Conditions do not work on Realms.
option.autoreconnectrf.conditions.type.t:
%s: Only reconnect if at least one condition matches.
%s: Only reconnect if no conditions match.
option.autoreconnectrf.conditions.keys.t:
Keys to check against the disconnect reason key, to determine whether to reconnect.

Last disconnect reason key:
%s
option.autoreconnectrf.conditions.patter:
Regex patterns to check against the disconnect reason string, to determine whether to reconnect.

Last disconnect reason string:
%s
option.autoreconnectrf.messages.tooltip: Messages to send after a successful automatic reconnect.
option.autoreconnectrf.messages.instance: A single AutoMessage object for a specific server, realm or world.
The server IP, realm name, or world name on which this AutoMessage should be used.
Time to wait before the sending the first message and between subsequent ones.

option.autoreconnectrf.misc.commandSigni: Whether to sign AutoMessage commands when sending. Certain servers may require this to be enabled.
option.autoreconnectrf.misc.regexIds.too: Whether to parse all AutoMessage Connection IDs as regex patterns. Only enable this if you know what you're doing.
